title: Rosemary Beach: Seaforth Cottage in Inlet Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Seaforth Cottage in Inlet Beach. *This Luxury rental is located in a private Community of 10 homes that share a gulf front pool and private beach of their own.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at The Bluffs with 2 sets of beach chairs and the Beach Better Box included (March 1 - October 31) . Additional beach service chairs can be rented through Jake's Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Inlet Beach - Luxury Collection

Soak up the Florida sunshine in the light and airy Seaforth Cottage, located in charming Inlet Beach. With gulf views from all four levels of the home, you'll find that Seaforth Cottage is a relaxing oasis for your family getaway.

Sit a while in the first floor outdoor living area near the properties three bubbling fountains, complete with a dining table for six, wet bar, flat screen television and grill. The outdoor space is so accommodating you may never want to venture inside; however, take the elevator to the second floor for even more outdoor living with gorgeous balcony views. The second level also boasts a fully-stocked chef's kitchen with stainless appliances, wine refrigerator, ice machine and Thermador professional range as well as a dining room, living room and guest bedroom with King bed and private bathroom.

Unwind after a long day at the beach in one of the three third floor bedrooms, all furnished with king beds and private bathrooms. Among these is the luxurious primary bedroom, with a walk-in closet and private balcony with love seat, two chairs and a coffee table. Take in the sunrise and sunset from your very own suite. You'll also find large, flat screen televisions in each bedroom, perfect for entertaining everyone during those occasional afternoon showers.

Finally, make your way to the fourth floor, where you'll find the ultimate relaxation zone. A large room features two sets of XL bunk beds (full over full) and a built-in XL twin bed with a trundle, as well as a private bathroom. Additionally, a second living room makes for the ideal space to sit back and take in a movie on the large flat-screen television with Sonos, and Blu-ray player. A wet bar with sink and mini-refrigerator ensures you never have to leave the comfort of the couch, which, by the way, spans the entire length of the wall. Just outside is another balcony with expansive gulf views - simply perfect for taking in our warm, Florida nights.

Seaforth Cottage couldn't be a more inviting place to spend your beach vacation with family and friends. From the stunning balcony views to the luxurious décor, this home delights in every possible way. Our beach is the only location along 30A that offers 350+ feet of private beach access, guaranteeing front row beach access to all of our guests. From March 1 - October 31, your family will receive 2 sets of beach chairs (4 chairs and 2 umbrellas) and a Beach Better Box. The Beach Better Box offers a Yeti Cooler stocked daily with fresh ice and 8 bottles of water, and 8 beach towels. We also offer complimentary access to the Rosemary Beach Fitness Center and Racquet Club. We invite you to spend your sojourn with us and we promise you won't be disappointed.

KEY FEATURES:

Outdoor entertainment space with dining for 6, wet bar, flat screen TV, and grill
5 bedrooms/5.5 bathrooms including 4 king bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and gulf-views from every floor
One house back from the beach with 350 ft of private beach for The Bluffs of Inlet Beach
2 sets of beach chairs and a Beach Better Box (March 1 - October 31)
Exclusive access to the Rosemary Beach Fitness Center and Racquet Club
Access to community pool (Heated Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's, and March 1 - Easter)
Please note: This community prohibits beach tents, canopies, sunshades, or wind assisted shades that may look like a tent. A beach umbrella is permitted.

Home Highlights:

1st floor: Outdoor living space including a dining table for 6, wet bar, flat-screen TV, gas grill, and a half bath.
2nd floor: Main living space with a half bath and first king bedroom with an en-suite bathroom.

2nd floor balcony: lounge seating for 6 and an outdoor dining table for 6

3rd floor: Master king bedroom with en-suite bathroom, 2 guest king bedrooms each with their own en-suite bathrooms, and the laundry room

3rd floor balcony: 2 club chairs and an oversized swivel chair with fantastic views of the gulf

4th floor: Bunk room with a bonus living space, flat screen TV, en-suite bathroom, and a wet bar with a mini fridge and sink.

4th floor balcony: gas fireplace with seating for 4 and 2 loungers to soak up the sun!

THIS PROPERTY RENTS FOR 7 NIGHTS SATURDAY - SATURDAY YEAR ROUND

*This Luxury rental is located in a private Community of 10 homes that share a gulf front pool and private beach of their own (beach only has 1 row of beach chairs!) Located outside the Rosemary Beach® community with no access to Rosemary Beach community pools or beach walkovers.
